interface.name: wkbmap_manager_unstable_v1
interface.description:
Allows a client to request a new XKB keyboard configuration for the current Wayland session.
The compositor is responsible for validating and applying the requested configuration.

request.name: set_xkb_config
request.description:
Set the XKB keyboard configuration for the current session.
Empty strings indicate that the corresponding XKB component should use its default value.
